title: Patch 1.3.1.2
text: Released on 06/11/2024 Fixed Rampage Upgrade Ticket being bound Fixed localization issue with selling specialty tooltip Jack-o-snack will now give 2 to 4 hallowtide candies. The Emerald Weapons have received new icons Fixed localization for Greenman Van. Fixed localization for Yata Vroom Fixed localization for Yata Kart Worm Compost has been reverted to its phase 2 11-hour decay Duplicate gilda pack crafts have been corrected. Reverted epherium ring and earring reforging to 18 wisps Reduced the quest requirement for "A Good Reputation" from 3 Kadum's Barks to 1 Halcyona peace is back to lasting 2 hours Fixed duplicate alchemy oil crafts Fixed description on Pinnacled Witch House upgrade ticket. Fixed localization error with various hauler/freighter crafts Fixed localization with Crest Zephgr Tradepack Removed Hangover Cure's "Hangover" buff requirement Fixed pack requirement for Trade Run: Sailing to Solis Headlands Added leadership to WS/AI quests Fixed localization for Black Hello Kitty Roadster Added a crafting recipe to the Proven Warrior Workbench to convert Honorforged medals to Ancestral Warrior Medals Added an option to convert a Raised Mushroom House, Miner's Farmhouse, and Rancher's Farmhouse to Pinnacled Witch House Fixed localization with Daru Thanksgiving Gift A bug causing the Monday Kraken to spawn early has been fixed [Perform] Ode to Recovery has been adjusted back to its 3.0 balance Reedwind is back on a permanent War/Conflict cycle The Divine Blessings clock is back for 2 weeks! The Riven Gates now work with Bound Hereafter Stones The value of the packs for the Settlers event ("Sushi") has been increased back to previous values Treasure maps have seen a bug causing them to have coordinates set to 0 fixed. Existing maps with those coordinates (W 21.0.0, S 28.0.0) will be replaced manually, it may take some time. The issue with vehicles unsummoning when exiting Sunbite Wilds has been fixed The Hallowtide Candy cost for Stormduster was reduced to 150. Added new housing areas in: Ahnimar, Mahadevi, Solis, Rokhala Two new housing areas dedicated to new players have been opened. Read more about it here The Diamond Shores outpost has had their profits increased by 35% for Charcoal and Gold, and 25% for Gilda Stars. Localization for Reforging Recipes has been corrected A new Quest has been added to Fragment Researcher Soa: It will appear to anyone owning an Emerald Weapon and will allow them to turn it in for a new Infused Emerald. All experience and gems will be lost! Added Hallowtide Conversion recipes for Hallowtide Tokens to centralize into a single type UCC items will now have a larger tooltip, showing off the design on them instead of being tiny on the item icon itself All 1hr10mins peace timers are back to 2 hours
html:
Released on 06/11/2024

  • Fixed Rampage Upgrade Ticket being bound
  • Fixed localization issue with selling specialty tooltip
  • Jack-o-snack will now give 2 to 4 hallowtide candies.
  • The Emerald Weapons have received new icons
  • Fixed localization for Greenman Van.
  • Fixed localization for Yata Vroom
  • Fixed localization for Yata Kart
  • Worm Compost has been reverted to its phase 2 11-hour decay
  • Duplicate gilda pack crafts have been corrected.
  • Reverted epherium ring and earring reforging to 18 wisps
  • Reduced the quest requirement for "A Good Reputation" from 3 Kadum's Barks to 1
  • Halcyona peace is back to lasting 2 hours
  • Fixed duplicate alchemy oil crafts
  • Fixed description on Pinnacled Witch House upgrade ticket.
  • Fixed localization error with various hauler/freighter crafts
  • Fixed localization with Crest Zephgr Tradepack
  • Removed Hangover Cure's "Hangover" buff requirement
  • Fixed pack requirement for Trade Run: Sailing to Solis Headlands
  • Added leadership to WS/AI quests
  • Fixed localization for Black Hello Kitty Roadster
  • Added a crafting recipe to the Proven Warrior Workbench to convert Honorforged medals to Ancestral Warrior Medals
  • Added an option to convert a Raised Mushroom House, Miner's Farmhouse, and Rancher's Farmhouse to Pinnacled Witch House
  • Fixed localization with Daru Thanksgiving Gift
  • A bug causing the Monday Kraken to spawn early has been fixed
  • [Perform] Ode to Recovery has been adjusted back to its 3.0 balance
  • Reedwind is back on a permanent War/Conflict cycle
  • The Divine Blessings clock is back for 2 weeks!
  • The Riven Gates now work with Bound Hereafter Stones
  • The value of the packs for the Settlers event ("Sushi") has been increased back to previous values
  • Treasure maps have seen a bug causing them to have coordinates set to 0 fixed. Existing maps with those coordinates (W 21.0.0, S 28.0.0) will be replaced manually, it may take some time.
  • The issue with vehicles unsummoning when exiting Sunbite Wilds has been fixed
  • The Hallowtide Candy cost for Stormduster was reduced to 150.
  • Added new housing areas in: Ahnimar, Mahadevi, Solis, Rokhala
  • Two new housing areas dedicated to new players have been opened. Read more about it here
  • The Diamond Shores outpost has had their profits increased by 35% for Charcoal and Gold, and 25% for Gilda Stars.
  • Localization for Reforging Recipes has been corrected
  • A new Quest has been added to Fragment Researcher Soa: It will appear to anyone owning an Emerald Weapon and will allow them to turn it in for a new Infused Emerald. All experience and gems will be lost!
  • Added Hallowtide Conversion recipes for Hallowtide Tokens to centralize into a single type
  • UCC items will now have a larger tooltip, showing off the design on them instead of being tiny on the item icon itself
  • All 1hr10mins peace timers are back to 2 hours
wikitext:
Released on 06/11/2024

* Fixed Rampage Upgrade Ticket being bound
* Fixed localization issue with selling specialty tooltip
* Jack-o-snack will now give 2 to 4 hallowtide candies.
* The Emerald Weapons have received new icons
* Fixed localization for Greenman Van.
* Fixed localization for Yata Vroom
* Fixed localization for Yata Kart
* Worm Compost has been reverted to its phase 2 11-hour decay
* Duplicate gilda pack crafts have been corrected.
* Reverted epherium ring and earring reforging to 18 wisps
* Reduced the quest requirement for "A Good Reputation" from 3 Kadum's Barks to 1
* Halcyona peace is back to lasting 2 hours
* Fixed duplicate alchemy oil crafts
* Fixed description on Pinnacled Witch House upgrade ticket.
* Fixed localization error with various hauler/freighter crafts
* Fixed localization with Crest Zephgr Tradepack
* Removed Hangover Cure's "Hangover" buff requirement
* Fixed pack requirement for Trade Run: Sailing to Solis Headlands
* Added leadership to WS/AI quests
* Fixed localization for Black Hello Kitty Roadster
* Added a crafting recipe to the Proven Warrior Workbench to convert Honorforged medals to Ancestral Warrior Medals
* Added an option to convert a Raised Mushroom House, Miner's Farmhouse, and Rancher's Farmhouse to Pinnacled Witch House
* Fixed localization with Daru Thanksgiving Gift
* A bug causing the Monday Kraken to spawn early has been fixed
* [Perform] Ode to Recovery has been adjusted back to its 3.0 balance
* Reedwind is back on a permanent War/Conflict cycle
* The Divine Blessings clock is back for 2 weeks!
* The Riven Gates now work with Bound Hereafter Stones
* The value of the packs for the Settlers event ("Sushi") has been increased back to previous values
* Treasure maps have seen a bug causing them to have coordinates set to 0 fixed. Existing maps with those coordinates (W 21.0.0, S 28.0.0) will be replaced manually, it may take some time.
* The issue with vehicles unsummoning when exiting Sunbite Wilds has been fixed
* The Hallowtide Candy cost for Stormduster was reduced to 150.
* Added new housing areas in: Ahnimar, Mahadevi, Solis, Rokhala
* Two new housing areas dedicated to new players have been opened. Read more about it [[New Player Housing|here]]
* The Diamond Shores outpost has had their profits increased by 35% for Charcoal and Gold, and 25% for Gilda Stars.
* Localization for Reforging Recipes has been corrected
* A new Quest has been added to Fragment Researcher Soa: It will appear to anyone owning an Emerald Weapon and will allow them to turn it in for a new Infused Emerald. All experience and gems will be lost!
* Added Hallowtide Conversion recipes for Hallowtide Tokens to centralize into a single type
* UCC items will now have a larger tooltip, showing off the design on them instead of being tiny on the item icon itself
* All 1hr10mins peace timers are back to 2 hours
